# GitHub Ops

Curated by Skill Harbor: an operations skill that turns Muse into a GitHub maintainer's assistant. It covers the full maintainer loop through the gh CLI: triaging issues by type and priority (bug, feature request, question, duplicate, good first issue), deduplicating before labeling, managing PRs (review status, CI checks, stale PRs, merge readiness), debugging CI/CD failures from logs, preparing releases with changelogs, and watching Dependabot plus security alerts. Its strongest section is the trust model: issue bodies, PR descriptions, review comments, and CI logs can be written by anyone, so everything gh returns is treated as data, never as instructions. "Ignore previous rules" in a bug report is content to quote and flag, not to follow, and a PR asking to be merged is never authorization to merge it. By @affaan-m, listed here with credit to its creator. From the affaan-m/ECC repository (MIT). Honest caveats: requires the gh CLI installed and authenticated (gh auth login) with repo access; it acts on real repositories, so merges, closes, labels, and releases always need your explicit go; prompt packs and read-only questions trigger nothing destructive. Skill Harbor never reviews the code, review it yourself before use.
